parameters.query:
WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM autofix.incident
    WHERE jira_key IS NULL
      AND jira_attempt_count < 5
      AND (
          status IN ('DETECTED', 'JIRA_FAILED')
          OR (
              status = 'JIRA_PENDING'
              AND jira_claimed_at <
                  NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
          )
      )
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE autofix.incident AS incident
SET
    status = 'JIRA_PENDING',
    jira_claimed_at = NOW(),
    jira_last_attempt_at = NOW(),
    jira_attempt_count =
        incident.jira_attempt_count + 1,
    jira_last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
FROM candidate
WHERE incident.id = candidate.id
RETURNING
    incident.id,
    incident.fingerprint,
    incident.service_name,
    incident.environment,
    incident.exception_type,
    incident.normalized_exception_message,
    incident.application_stack_frame,
    incident.first_seen_at,
    incident.last_seen_at,
    incident.occurrence_count,
    incident.sample_correlation_id,
    incident.sample_request_path,
    incident.sample_http_method,
    incident.sample_stack_trace,
    incident.status,
    incident.jira_attempt_count;

parameters.query:
UPDATE autofix.incident
SET
    jira_key = $2,
    status = 'JIRA_CREATED',
    jira_created_at = COALESCE(
        jira_created_at,
        NOW()
    ),
    jira_claimed_at = NULL,
    jira_last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1
  AND jira_key IS NULL
RETURNING
    id,
    fingerprint,
    jira_key,
    status,
    jira_attempt_count;

UPDATE autofix.incident
SET
    jira_key = $2,
    status = 'JIRA_CREATED',
    jira_created_at = NOW(),
    jira_claimed_at = NULL,
    jira_last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1
  AND jira_key IS NULL
RETURNING
    id,
    fingerprint,
    jira_key,
    status,
    jira_attempt_count,
    jira_created_at;
